But coincidentally, there were two uninvited helpers whom she was inexplicably familiar with, and she was no longer in the mood to snap at them.
<@lv.item><Mark of Hui and Ming></> Operators deployed on it gain a Hui-Ming Attribute.

char_225_haak.name: Just Take Your Medicine
char_225_haak.description:
Aak would always dispense mysterious medicine to the most anxious operators on the battlefield. After ingesting them, their fighting prowess would momentarily and substantially boosted, and victory came easy. But the side effects also made everyone who took them suffer, some would doze off, some would have their hair curl, and some could never get the taste of durian out of their mouth.
<@lv.item><Snowsant's Safe Escape Crane></> Immediately withdraws an Operator, and greatly reduces Redeployment Time.

char_322_lmlee.name: Money-making Expert
char_322_lmlee.description:
It is very worthwhile to ask someone like Lee to help you out, for no matter how big or small the task, he is sure to leave you satisfied. The price may be high sometimes, but if you have the time to chat with him about everything under the sky, and also savor a few cups of exquisite sweet tea with him, he may offer you a small discount.
<@lv.rem>DP recovery rate is decreased.</>
<@lv.item><Roadblocks></> Deploy to block the enemy's route.

char_473_mberry.name: Compatriots
char_473_mberry.description: Even when surrounded by her Yanese compatriots with no language barrier between them, Mulberry is still the quietest person in her group. But there's no need to worry about missing her during dispatches, for her confidence in her expertise at finding a safe way out is unparalleled.

char_476_blkngt.name: Little Buddies
char_476_blkngt.description:
Blacknight understands just how important it is to have trustworthy partners living out in the wilderness. It's true that having outstanding abilities will let you survive in the harsh environment for a while, but the real difficulty is surviving loneliness.
And everything out here is hard to come by, water, food, medicine... and companions.
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>

char_492_quercu.name: As Things Should Be
char_492_quercu.description: May this great land forgive the sacrifices of the fearless, and let life grow evergreen.

char_338_iris.name: Fairy-tale Wish
char_338_iris.description:
May every child, no matter how old they grow or how far they go, be able to pause momentarily and recall the fairy tales they heard when they were young.
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>

char_349_chiave.name: Genius Commander
char_349_chiave.description:
Chiave can not only make quick repairs and modifications to Rhodes Island's support robots, but also even increase their operational efficiency. While most of the Engineering operators believe that his technical expertise has let him establish some sort of efficient human-computer interaction, Chiave attributes it to his own genius and claims that one day everyone else will be able to benefit from it as well—although his two best buddies would never admit it.
<@lv.item><Deep Water Zone></> Unable to deploy on these tiles. Enemies on these tiles have reduced ASPD and Movement Speed, and continually lose HP.

char_300_phenxi.name: Afternoon Time
char_300_phenxi.description:
Fiammetta lives up to her Lateran roots when it comes to enjoying desserts. She rarely admits it, but partaking in a delicious soft serve is certainly the ideal way to spent a leisurely afternoon in Laterano.
Of course, it would be even better if the target she's meant to supervise didn't get her into trouble, and the streets were free of unapproved explosions.
<@lv.item><Exhaust Grille></> Operators deployed on this tile will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks.
<@lv.item><'Gelato Stop'></> Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, restores SP of surrounding allies.

char_4055_bgsnow.name: To Write Of Sorrow
char_4055_bgsnow.description:
One of the reasons Pozëmka doesn't like walking around bright and sunny Zeruertza with her crossbow in tow is because the way she easily lifts her weapon with one hand looks extremely out of place among the Durin.
However, when she paces back and forth with her crossbow in a deserted open field while contemplating her manuscripts, she is usually facing her nightmares alone.
<@lv.rem>DP recovery rate is decreased.</>
<@lv.item><Deep Water Zone></> Unable to deploy on these tiles. Enemies on these tiles have reduced ASPD and Movement Speed, and continually lose HP.
<@lv.item><Custom Floating Platform></> Can be deployed on Deep Water Zones, thereafter any unit can be deployed on that tile. The platform is destroyed when the deployed unit retreats.

char_343_tknogi.name: Protection
char_343_tknogi.description:
Tsukinogi is quite popular. Many operators are happy to travel with her in the field, listening to her ramble about her interesting experiences as a Catastrophe Messenger, or her strange and little-known stories of Higashi.
But not many know this: Tsukinogi's abundance of travel buddies is not solely due to her personal charm. It's also from the way she shows up on the battlefield: the light that pours from her staff protects each and every one of her companions from harm.

char_383_snsant.name: Efficient Pest Control
char_383_snsant.description:
'Still struggling with Originium Slugs slithering around? Try Snowsant's Electric Net—no matter what it is, if it explodes, if it smells, if it freezes people, or even splits itself into smaller ones, you can catch them all at once!'
—A poster Vanilla chanced upon in the corridor

char_366_acdrop.name: Marksmanship Mentoring
char_366_acdrop.description:
People generally have the impression that a lightweight hand crossbow doesn't have the capacity to be lethal. However, in the hands of a skateboarding Aciddrop, the weapon is sure to hit the enemy's weak spots, devastating even heavily armored foes.
Younger operators often seek her out to ask for marksmanship lessons, and she has never refused. But no matter how fast or slow a learner they are, or even if they go to her for advice and end up even more confused than before, her lessons always end with fried onion rings.
<@lv.item><Roadblocks></> Deploy to block the enemy's route.

char_325_bison.name: Fighting With Friends
char_325_bison.description:
Bison and his friends from Penguin Logistics form an unbreakable frontline on the battlefield. While it's true that each of them have their own specialties they use in combat to make things easier for themselves, the real reason why their line of defense is impregnable is because of their shared experiences: some bizarre, some ludicrous, some thrilling, and some even heartwarming.
<@lv.rem><Command Terminal></> Depletes 1 Life Point when destroyed.

char_254_vodfox.name: Little Terror
char_254_vodfox.description:
Shamare uses fear as a means to protect herself, and treats Morte as her only companion.
 —Of course, since arriving at Rhodes Island, she's no longer been alone with Morte in tow.
Don't be afraid of her; the ones who should be afraid are her enemies.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></> Depletes a Life Point when killed by an enemy.
<@lv.item><Static Roadblock></> Blocks the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.

char_265_sophia.name: Personalized Lessons
char_265_sophia.description:
Helping others find their own style of fighting is not an easy task. Not only do you have to help them find their strengths and adapt familiar techniques to their advantage, you also have to make them understand their enemies and environments. Zofia is undoubtedly well-known for this amongst all the instructors, regardless of whether her students are the daughters of the Nearl family or Rhodes Island's operators.
<@lv.item><Mieszko Coil></> Obtain Activation effect when within range of other Mieszko Coils.
<@lv.item><Portable Supply Station></> Grants additional SP to a character or Command Terminal.

char_328_cammou.name: Machine Assistance
char_328_cammou.description:
Even for an outdoor videographer of some fame like Click, good shoots and postproc hit the wallet hard. Still, Rhodes Island's Engineering Department doesn't just do her drone repair for under half the price, they throw in a bunch of refits and remodels too. Sure, she feels a little awkward taking advantage of it, but hey, if kits this cheap AND functional is a perk of sticking with the firm, then that sounds fair to her!
<@lv.item><Portable Supply Station></> Grants additional SP to a character or Command Terminal.

char_4042_lumen.name: A Shimmer in Stormy Seas
char_4042_lumen.description:
Whether a care worker at Gran Faro, an Inquisitor for Iberia, or a Rhodes Island operator, Lumen has always done every last thing he can to provide support and aid to his companions. Perhaps it is precisely the sight of that lantern, undying in the most tempestuous storms, which allows us to set aside the barriers of region or race, and trust him with all our heart and soul.
<@lv.item><Emergency Aid Building></> Once activated, continually treats surrounding units affected by Nervous Impairment.
<@lv.item><Hand of the Saint></> Bounces a 'Hand of the Saint' in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

char_294_ayer.name: Defensive Prowess
char_294_ayer.description: Even in the most hostile environments, Ayerscarpe has never failed to unflinchingly carry out his duties. An original combat style is far from the only method he has to clear the way—being a professional bodyguard, he knows just as well how to display his own abilities in a team operation.

char_373_lionhd.name: Forces, Deconstructed
char_373_lionhd.description:
As a highly seasoned Catastrophe Messenger, Leonhardt's intimately familiar with sweeping the message's path clean of all obstacles—first you find high ground with open visibility, then he can unleash his 'Detonation Arts' on all in front of him without fear or restraint. What? What about behind him, you ask? Don't worry, there'll always be someone to swiftly dispose of the enemies who think they're so smart.
<@lv.item><Portable Supply Station></> Grants additional SP to a character or Command Terminal.

char_4063_quartz.name: No Return
char_4063_quartz.description: No matter the challenge or the danger, or how thoroughly she's surrounded, the Quartz today will never waver or hesitate again. Bring it!

char_4048_doroth.name: Rebuild It, Dorothy
char_4048_doroth.description:
Uninvited guests tear down brick walls and raze the fields, and Dorothy is patient as she draws them into her trap. She will never allow anyone to harm her friends. Now look back, quick, for there's still room to redeem it all.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.
<@lv.item><Portable Supply Station></> Grants additional SP to a character or Command Terminal.
<@lv.item><Tattered Pillar></> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.
<@lv.item><Demolition Device></> Directly knocks down a Tattered Pillar one tile in front.

char_4071_peper.name: 'Don't Touch My Friends!'
char_4071_peper.description:
On the battlefield, Paprika always takes it upon herself to look after every companion of hers. Even if her power falls short at times, she'll never let even a single compatriot fall by the wayside.
'Of course I'll save you! Because we're friends in this together!' says the young Sarkaz.

char_379_sesa.name: All-Out Attack
char_379_sesa.description:
Sesa's journey has been at times lonesome, faced with all manner of danger in all forms of flux, nipping at his heels. Even still, he has full faith that by his own power, he can shatter it all to pieces.
<@lv.item><Mr. Boom></> Stun all enemies in the four adjacent tiles for a long duration.

char_326_glacus.name: Aviatory Lockdown
char_326_glacus.description: When she stares up at the sky, Glaucus always envies the fowlbeasts, wheeling about the horizon. But illegally flown drones scare fowlbeasts off, and Glaucus will find a way to win the skies back for them.

char_193_frostl.name: Her Squad
char_193_frostl.description:
The young mercenary has arrived someplace new. Here, your teammates lend you a helping hand. Here, your companions have your back firmly covered. Here, your squad is your sanctuary, and not just some figment that could fall part at any moment. The young mercenary stands in a land of ice and snow, but her heart feels so very warm.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.

char_4043_erato.name: Sweet Dreams Abyssal
char_4043_erato.description: From the rugged mountains of Minos comes she, Erato, ever the defender of the lofty virtue that dwells within her bosom. Should filthy feelers dare to reach for the shore, her arrows will drive them back to their abyssal land of slumber, no quarter shown.

char_497_ctable.name: Lie Low
char_497_ctable.description:
Concealed in the shadows, her attacks clean and swift, Cantabile now has her reason to act firmly. Just give her a momentary break to rest, and she can return straight back to the field. After all, she has an adorable, lively little Metal Crab waiting for her once the battle is through.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.
<@lv.item><Mr. Boom></> Stun all enemies in the four adjacent tiles for a long duration.

char_4016_kazema.name: Co-Conspiracy
char_4016_kazema.description: As an intelligence officer, Kazemaru knows how to effectively handle situations in which enemy count plainly exceeds our own personnel. Even though they haven't met, this true ally-in-arms of ours will note her presence on the field, and provide timely support.

char_347_jaksel.name: Seconds from Disaster
char_347_jaksel.description: Jackie's the 'act now, think later' type of operator. When in the thick of crises and pitfalls, she's not going to worry about any consequences or consider a safe retreat beforehand or anything. She's gonna go all out, right to the bitter end!

char_279_excu.name: Pensum Exsecutoris
char_279_excu.description:
Laterano Notarial Hall Executor Federico has a seasoned mission history, with one-on-many battles practically commonplace for him. Never forget, however, that executors do much more than fight alone. They're equally proficient at linking up, coordinating, and coming to one another's aid.
<@lv.item><Snowsant's Safe Escape Crane></> Immediately withdraws an Operator, and greatly reduces Redeployment Time.
<@lv.item><'Gelato Stop'></> Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, restores SP of surrounding allies

char_4036_forcer.name: Consilium Praeparatorius
char_4036_forcer.description:
Time and again, Enforcer's thought about how he could best protect Cecelia if the time came to fight, and he was all that stood between them and her. His final conclusion: Elect for the most suitable terrain, exploit what advantages he has, and keep her safe to the bitter end.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.
<@lv.item><Roadblocks></> Deploy to block the enemy's route.

char_306_leizi.name: Repute Presides, All Else Follows
char_306_leizi.description: For a criminal case, the law of Yan is merely the final gate. To every soul that opposes the arbiters of right and wrong, however, Yanese law is the land's first roll of thunder. Repute presides, all else follows—judgment passes itself at the very outset.

char_4046_ebnhlz.name: Ruhelosigkeit
char_4046_ebnhlz.description:
When looking back on that night of pandemonium, Ebenholz often thinks that he should've perhaps been more cautious, or more firm—he even wonders if in that fateful moment, he should have picked up the authority and responsibility he'd cast away like a pair of worn-out shoes... In any case, no matter what, he should have done more.
<@lv.item><Realigned Flux></> Restores natural SP recovery rate of allied Operators within.

char_1024_hbisc2.name: Twinflowers
char_1024_hbisc2.description: It's been a long journey for the Londinium-born sisters that left home. They've witnessed the endemic malice of the lands, and met many a dependable friend. From ignorant children to fully-fledged independents—one a fighter, one a healer—parting and reuniting more times than they can count has left only each other stood by their sides.

char_493_firwhl.name: 'A Warm Welcome'
char_493_firwhl.description: A sheltered front, cramped terrain, a mess of enemies, and a distinct lack of fire safety... As far as Firewhistle's concerned, everything's primed to go, just waiting for her to personally light the flame.

char_214_kafka.name: Something Wicked This Way Comes
char_214_kafka.description:
Kafka's been in all mighty manner of predicaments, but making it out unscathed is her game every time. The secret to her sauce lies in her gutsy gall and eye for detail—no opportunity that works to her benefit escapes her grasp, and when she's out for success, success knows something wicked this way comes.
<@lv.item><Deep Water Zone></> Unable to deploy on these tiles. Enemies on these tiles have reduced ASPD and Movement Speed, and continually lose HP.
<@lv.item><Custom Floating Platform></> Can be deployed on Deep Water Zones, thereafter any unit can be deployed on that tile. The platform is destroyed when the deployed unit retreats.

char_4004_pudd.name: All Charged Up
char_4004_pudd.description: During her shut-in days, Pudding absorbed herself in her electrical engineering studies, accumulating professional expertise bit by bit. Now she finally has the courage to step outside, oversupplying the battlefield with electricity in one fell swoop. If that accidentally zaps an enemy or two in the process, that's not on her, is it?

char_337_utage.name: Guardian Trendsetter
char_337_utage.description:
The ever laid-back Utage's always drifting through stores large and small. If it's trendy and she's into it, she'll get it, even in the far-flung reaches of Acahualla. Still, it isn't all chill for vogue-hunters—when business competition starts sending waves her way, it threatens to wreck the all-new drip she's been eyeing forever. Utage's gotten serious, and she's gonna teach these tribe guys to respect fashion.
<@lv.item><Giant Mushroom></> Increases the DEF of neighboring allied units.

char_249_mlyss.name: 'Personal Experience'
char_249_mlyss.description: She knows every person she's ever met. She remembers what they like and what they don't, and she remembers how they fight. When you can give being someone else a shot and save yourself some effort, what's stopping you? <@lv.rem>DP recovery rate is decreased. <@lv.item> Absorbs nearby experimental products to recover SP. Activates when SP is full.

char_466_qanik.name: Snowstorm in a Bottle
char_466_qanik.description:
The quiet skills he developed playing in the snow as a child are just as applicable now in his work and missions as an adult. As his targets bunch up, one, two, three, Qanipalaat raises his staff, and the blizzard obeys, sending them tumbling into the air.
<@lv.rem>DP recovery rate is decreased.</>

char_4032_provs.name: 'Speech is Gold'
char_4032_provs.description:
As a first-class trial attorney, Proviso has ample experience arguing in the courtroom. The secret to her continued success: never giving her opponent a chance to act.
<@lv.rem>DP recovery rate is increased.</>

char_475_akafyu.name: Ronin with Sword in Hand
char_475_akafyu.description:
Akafuyu is a general who's long walked the battlefield, where fighting against the odds has been all too common. With her katana, she'll pry life and deal death, even in the face of despairing numbers.
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian></>Depletes a Life Point when killed by an enemy.

char_135_halo.name: Asterisms, Twinkling in Twin
char_135_halo.description:
Elena doesn't even need to turn around to know that her sister's got her back, and that's what gives her the utmost confidence that no matter when, no matter where, she'll always have that sincere warmth shining on her side.
<@lv.item><Medical Rune></> Operators deployed on this tile will restore HP over time.
<@lv.item><R-Series Power Armor></> Absorbs nearby experimental products to recover SP. Activates when SP is full.

char_1027_greyy2.name: Light's Source
char_1027_greyy2.description:
Light gives people a sense of security. The unknown, the dread, the fear, all disappear when the lights go on. Here Greyy stands, reinforcer of the light, the dawn breaking through the dark.
<@lv.item><Emergency Aid Building></> Once activated, continually treats surrounding units affected by Nervous Impairment.

char_150_snakek.name: Key Player
char_150_snakek.description: Cuora's gonna defend her team's rear, and she's not gonna miss a single pitch that flies her way. Who could've guessed the star of a ballgame would be the one carrying a backpack?

char_502_nblade.name: Spearhead Unwavering
char_502_nblade.description:
Lead the advance, cut open the way. How Yato does her job has stayed constant, even to this day.
Even through the quiet shifts in her mission in life, even under the many eyes that see her as their hope, she remains a vanguard, first and foremost a spearhead.
<@lv.item><Tattered Pillar></> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.

char_151_myrtle.name: 'The Very Model of a Durin Generalissimo'
char_151_myrtle.description:
In Myrtle's hands, even a white tablecloth becomes a banner to rouse a whole army. Don't let that blind you to the aid she provides her team, though—her teammates' surge of fighting spirit is proof the 'Generalissimo's' morale boosting isn't just hot air.
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>

char_491_humus.name: 'Stern as Steel'
char_491_humus.description:
Benefitting from years of combat experience and his body's sturdy build, Humus always hits the field with a promise to hold key passages and keep enemy reinforcements at bay. When you add in the will driving him, stern as steel, it more than guarantees he'll be fighting to the very last moment.
<@lv.item><Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery></> Once fully charged, deals area True damage to both allies and enemies, centered on the friendly unit with the highest Block.

char_1026_gvial2.name: 'Invincible'
char_1026_gvial2.description:
'Gavial's standing out there all alone, but it's like SHE'S the one with the advantage.
'They charge her while she's just frowning at her own weapons, like—what's today, the chainsaw, the axe, or the staff? So then she shrugs and goes with all of them.
'And then a moment later, she's the last one standing on the battlefield, and it's just her and her chainsaw roaring. I could feel that sound as hard as I felt my own heart pounding.'
—Extract from a thick-tailed Archosauria's notes

char_4054_malist.name: 'A Trip Down Memory Lane'
char_4054_malist.description: After a training session simulating Zeruertza, Minimalist adamantly denied how happy it made him, but soon hurried to ask if a few more such sessions couldn't be scheduled.

char_220_grani.name: 'Sally Lone, Child of Sleipnir'
char_220_grani.description:
Fighting in this simulated training reproduction of Dewville couldn't be more familiar for Grani. Pike sharpened, armor polished, and always ready to struggle until it's done, she braves the fray once more.
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>
<@lv.item><Medical Rune></> Operators deployed on this tile will restore HP over time.
<@lv.item><Eroded Path></> Operators deployed on these tiles have their DEF reduced by half.

char_4041_chnut.name: 'Concentrate'
char_4041_chnut.description: Gemstones may gleam prettily, but their beauty's no shallow thing. Blossom them with brilliance, and they become stars to light up the dark; bring their rays together as one, and they'll startle you with an energy to rival the sun, one that drives away all coldness, vexation, and confusion!

char_120_hibisc.name: 'Continued Attention'
char_120_hibisc.description:
'I heard they'd be holding some kind of extreme-environment combat drill at the Training Grounds, so I went to go take a peek, and it was horrible! People standing on burning floors for the longest time, without even flinching! The instructors repeatedly assured me that they could guarantee everyone's safety and I didn't need to be there healing them all from the rear... but ohhhh, I just couldn't help but worry!'
—From Operator Hibiscus's application for authorization to participate in the training exercise
<@lv.item><Heat Pump Passage></> Periodically deals great damage to any units on it.
<@lv.item><Stun Generator></> Pay a cost to activate it, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

char_1032_excu2.name: Safe Framework
char_1032_excu2.description:
During combat, Executor has always had a knack for rapidly evaluating the enemy's status, upon which he can draw up an agile and effective tactical formation for his team. For any given assignment, he'll assume the duties of recon, engagement, skirmishing, breakthrough, impedance, and infiltration... We gather you're asking what everyone else does? Well, support, presumably. If it's ever necessary.
<@lv.item><Interferential Mine></> Upon explosion, deals heavy damage to enemies in the surrounding tiles and amplifies the damage they take for 15 seconds.

char_421_crow.name: Una Pluma en los Vientos
char_421_crow.description:
Anyone who emerges from the flames of war, even a child, carries a strikingly different aura.
You see La Pluma venture onto the battlefield with eyes honest and limpid, but those eyes betray no naivety as to her whereabouts—the opposite, in fact. They announce that she is far too familiar with this place.
And she knows where her sickle ought to sweep.
<@lv.rem>DP recovery rate is decreased.</>
<@lv.item><Deep Water Zone></> Unable to deploy on these tiles. Enemies on these tiles have reduced ASPD and Movement Speed, and continually lose HP.
<@lv.item><Custom Floating Platform></> Can be deployed on Deep Water Zones, thereafter any unit can be deployed on that tile. The platform is destroyed when the deployed unit retreats.

char_385_finlpp.name: Cleansed
char_385_finlpp.description:
No one can ensure the rivers will remain eternally unsoiled. Contamination, diffusion, dilution... these processes take their silent toll, and in the end, the water will be clean once again.
But though the water washes away all, and nature erases all trace, it doesn't deter her from using what little power she has to accelerate the purification.
Faster, now, just a little faster still.

char_4039_horn.name: Soundeth the Clarion
char_4039_horn.description:
The frontline is barren save for Horn fighting bitterly on, shield weighing down her grip, heavy artillery scorching her back, and naught left before her but the endless smoke of war. A moment's silence, then she whistles bright and clear, issuing herself the order to fight while the clarion has been lost.
She will make her charge, for those who are still alive, and for those who have fallen.
<@lv.item><Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery></> Once fully charged, deals area True damage to both allies and enemies, centered on the friendly unit with the highest Block.

char_157_dagda.name: Through Thick and Thin
char_157_dagda.description:
No matter when or where, Dagda never needs eyes on the back of her head as long as she's with the Glasgow Gang. When a set of steel claws doesn't send the enemy packing, adding in a hammer, a machete, and a pair of knuckles will guarantee the lot of them have nothing to fear.
<@lv.rem>DP recovery rate is decreased.</>
<@lv.item><Allerdale's Guard></> Forms an AOE barrier for allies.

char_369_bena.name: Shan't Leave Well Alone
char_369_bena.description:
Should you provoke Bena's ire, or Annie's, or... heaven forbid, both at once, you'd best prepare yourself. They'll be eyeing you, following you, one exhausted only to swap out for the other, and they won't stop until you either repent, or collapse.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.
<@lv.item><City Neon></> Provides an initial amount of visibility, and can further increase visibility when used.

char_190_clour.name: An Arrow Left the Rain
char_190_clour.description:
Stride by stride, a girl wades through the mud, only lifting her head now and then to check the way forward, a series of silent footprints following right behind her. She could not say how long she's been on the way home, and only once the end is in sight does she finally decide to bid farewell.
All of a sudden come strange sounds from around her, and she grasps her longbow tight. Now, nothing can get in her way, not to mention the companions who stand by her side.
She passes through the curtain of rain, and never looks back.

char_4062_totter.name: Arrowpoint of Rent Skies
char_4062_totter.description:
As a long-range sniper, Totter rarely takes to the front lines, by and large laying low at the very rear to provide solid, timely fire support for the Defender Operators ahead. While frontline operators afford him defense, Totter in turn sees to his fellows-in-arms' protection via every last one of his menacing arrowheads, liable to rend the skies.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.
<@lv.item><City Neon></> Provides an initial amount of visibility, and can further increase visibility when used.

char_261_sddrag.name: The Weight of a Life
char_261_sddrag.description:
Reed's flames are the flames of Life. Having been through the hopelessness and helplessness of County Hillock, she is still bewildered, yet breaking her will be no easy thing. Be ingenious in deploying support items, watch closely the enemy's movements, and you can leave the rest to her.
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>
<@lv.item><Mire></> Gradually reduces the ASPD of Operators within, and the ASPD and Movement Speed of enemies within.
<@lv.item><Reeds></> Operators within gain Camouflage.
<@lv.item><Tattered Pillar></> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.
<@lv.item><Interferential Mine> </>Upon explosion, deals heavy damage to enemies in the surrounding tiles and amplifies the damage they take for 15 seconds.

char_4045_heidi.name: Watertight
char_4045_heidi.description:
A years-long Messenger lifestyle leads Heidi to survey her surroundings out of habit, so as to swiftly support her nearby teammates. Though unable to fight, she can still exert her influence on the battlefield, nimbly providing different buffs to allies as the situation demands.
<@lv.rem>Allies have greatly reduced cost limit.</>

char_4105_almond.name: Tooth and Nail
char_4105_almond.description: Just give Almond the right terrain, and the smallsome Engineering specialist's ready to put her equipment to work, alleviating frontline pressure. Even if the enemy might be too tough to handle, Almond can root them to the spot for the precious few moments needed for a teammate to circle back and get it dealt with.

char_197_poca.name: Nurture to Nature
char_197_poca.description:
Rosa didn't start out knowing how to operate the siege device in her hands, that much was clear. In the process of fleeing Chernobog, it was at most a tool to open up the way. As she's grown accustomed to Rhodes Island life, though, so too has her understanding of the weapon grown deeper, bit by bit. Now, as far as she's concerned, to tote it is as natural as playing the piano.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.

char_427_vigil.name: Nell'alluvione
char_427_vigil.description: There's a peculiar sound to the current, because a stone has stopped its original course. Vigil casts a boulder into the rapids, hoping it'll wake the waters, or at least tarry their flow, so they can return to the fountainhead and give new thought to where they should go. He's determined to do something. <@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation. <@lv.rem>Allies have greatly reduced cost limit.

char_4047_pianst.name: Melodie über das Schlachtfeld
char_4047_pianst.description: Czerny is not fond of public appearances. Nor fame, nor wealth, nor riches, nor power. Unfortunately, his type draws all the more attention the truer they are to themselves, wherever they may be. <@lv.item> Restores natural SP recovery rate of allied Operators within.

char_341_sntlla.name: The Blizzard Descends
char_341_sntlla.description:
She is the breathless gale, and the cutthroat hailstorm. Faced with Ursus soldiers, the chill she conjures is never sparing. Of course, she's learned self-control these days, so at the very least, this biting blizzard won't bring harm to the Ursine children who walk with her.
<@lv.item><Exhaust Grille></> Operators deployed on this tile will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks.

char_4025_aprot2.name: Come Ye to the Limelight
char_4025_aprot2.description:
Never did Shalem imagine that one day, the limelight would be his. Here he must stand firm as the 'audience' throngs, and use the equipment he carries, coordinating with others to ford the crisis. If only the Troupe were as acquiescent a foe—oh, would that it could be.
<@lv.item><Medical Rune></> Operators deployed on this tile will restore HP over time.
<@lv.item><First Aid Kit></> Restores some HP to an allied unit.

char_206_gnosis.name: Overlooking Wind and Snow
char_206_gnosis.description:
Gnosis fights in the same way he conducts research. He likes to find a vantage spot with a good view of the overall situation, and efficiently solve his problems after understanding the whole picture.
Fighting alongside him is quite pleasant, as long as you can tolerate his temper. He will factor in everything you thought of and everything you didn't. You need only do your part.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.
<@lv.item><Icy Surface></> Applies 'Cold' to units on top of it, and increases the distance Frozen enemies on it are shifted.

char_4013_kjera.name: Accompanying Mountains
char_4013_kjera.description:
Engineering once borrowed Kjera's drone for research. They were curious: how could a simple stone function as a drone? The research bore no fruit, because no matter what they tried, it seemed only to be a uniquely shaped hunk of rock.
As they watched it precisely attack and freeze enemies on the battlefield, just as Kjera willed it, they could only scratch their heads and attribute it to her mysterious abilities.
<@lv.item><Icy Surface></> Applies 'Cold' to units on top of it, and increases the distance Frozen enemies on it are shifted.

char_297_hamoni.name: Heavy Dance Steps
char_297_hamoni.description:
Harmonie may seem undisciplined on the battlefield, but she knows how to use the information she has. Prey attracted by her bait will only realize they're trapped deep within her Arts when they feel something grabbing their throats.
<@lv.item><Mire></> Gradually reduces the ASPD of Operators within, and the ASPD and Movement Speed of enemies within.
<@lv.item><Reeds></> Operators within gain Camouflage.

char_488_buildr.name: Don't Wreck The Place
char_488_buildr.description:
A brick, a tile, a branch... Beautiful buildings rise from the ground, and here lie the builders' aspirations along with the home-seekers' obsessions. There're some bad guys who want to raze them to the ground? Then they'd better get through Poncirus first!
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>
<@lv.rem><Command Terminal></> Depletes 1 Life Point when destroyed.

char_4006_melnte.name: The Shortest and Straightest Line
char_4006_melnte.description:
Melanite's unusual fighting style is due to her unusual weapon. Rather than eliminating enemies one by one, she prefers to have a commander who can lure them all into a chokepoint where she can hit them all in one shot.
<@lv.item><Roadblocks></> Deploy to block the enemy's route.
<@lv.item><Portable Supply Station></> Grants additional SP to a character or Command Terminal.

char_381_bubble.name: No Beatings For Nothing
char_381_bubble.description: Bubble, who used to rampage across the training grounds, has learned to find the most advantageous position for her. Even if she's just taking hits while standing still, she can handle an endless wave of enemies without a hitch! Of course, she plans to demonstrate this to Gavial—she's Gavial's number one fan after all!

char_212_ansel.name: Cool-headed Supporter
char_212_ansel.description: Ansel lacks the stamina to run long-distances on the battlefield, nor is he good at 'Adrenaline Burst' style first-aid. He can only focus on healing with his hands. But everyone in the reserve team trusts him. They know that even if they had to hold a frontline on their own, Ansel would definitely be able to support them in time.

char_4082_qiubai.name: In the Same Boat
char_4082_qiubai.description: Be they iron fists or vials of spores, they need only share Qiubai's drive, and her sword will ensure they all shine brighter for it.

char_4083_chimes.name: On the Mountain Trail
char_4083_chimes.description: Hike through the mountains enough, and you tend to learn how and when you can throw off the wildlife. If you've got a travel buddy to lean on too, that'll make even the nastiest beasts manageable.

char_2024_chyue.name: 'Guest Starring...'
char_2024_chyue.description:
'The Scrollbound Spirit Army is at our gates! The Sage of Wine won't lift a finger! The fate of the city now lies with you, Grandmaster!'
—From a movie poster in the Rhodes Island corridors
<@lv.item><Medical Rune></>Operators deployed on this tile will restore HP over time.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.

char_4009_irene.name: A Rapier's Weight
char_4009_irene.description: Rather than putting on airs about her duty and mission as an Inquisitor, Irene likes to prove her conviction through action. Against the cultists and Seaborn, her rapier shan't spare a single foe. None can ascertain if her tiny stature will be able to withstand the billowing tides, but there's one thing they can be sure of—hers is a lantern undying.

char_4065_judge.name: Solid as Faith
char_4065_judge.description:
Penance always shows up where she is most needed, at the very front, without fear, come what may. Her enemies should fear her, for they stand against justice itself. In more practical terms, they will soon find that Penance's shield is as unbreakable as her conviction, and her hammer equally heavy.
<@lv.item><Blood Ledger></> All enemies are boosted and a Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

char_4015_spuria.name: The Gunsmith
char_4015_spuria.description:
Many operators have been on the receiving end of Spuria's practical jokes, but you can trust her when she says she wants to help modify a firearm, or when she says she has an idea to increase firepower in a pinch.
<@lv.item><Medical Rune></> Operators deployed on this tile will restore HP over time.
<@lv.item><Defensive Rune></> Operators deployed on it have increased DEF.

char_4014_lunacu.name: Barrenland Ambush
char_4014_lunacu.description: For Lunacub, nothing's more important than concealing yourself before the hunt. And once it's begun, it's simple—just take out all your prey before they notice you.

char_154_morgan.name: It's All About Being Quick
char_154_morgan.description:
Morgan is always active in battle, in the literal sense of the word. While her friends are experts at defending a stationary position, she prefers to be mobile and fluid, hitting the enemy where they are weakest, then pulling out before they can react. Such tactics have their risks, but it's all part of the thrill for her.
<@lv.item><Medical Rune></> Operators deployed on this tile will restore HP over time.
<@lv.item><Snowsant's Safe Escape Crane></> Immediately withdraws an Operator, and greatly reduces Redeployment Time.

char_4107_vrdant.name: Keep Off The Grass
char_4107_vrdant.description: Verdant's always been diligent, but never afraid. Confront him with danger, and he'll rev up his handsaw and spritz the compounds, tag-teaming with his Scarecrow and whipping out sturdy vines to lash down any rowdy foes trespassing in his field. Never does he beg others for protection—he'll take the plunge all by his steadfast self. Anyone trampling on the grass will hear from him: What you see as harmless plants will not let themselves be walked over.

char_4132_ascln.name: Lone Blade
char_4132_ascln.description: Only those who melt into the dark can know what deathly iciness would chill the dawning light of day. So Ascalon lives and breathes—she and her shadow prowl through the darkness, filtering past all danger as they go. Out of the light of day, with no plan to return.

char_446_aroma.name: Surfactancy
char_446_aroma.description: Even in the field, Aroma never forgets a single trick she's learned as a cleaner. Water and foam are her weapons of choice, able to rob the enemy of all footing. You tackle them like you tackle the most stubborn stains—never let them set, and never let them make things worse!

char_367_swllow.name: Bolt by Bolt
char_367_swllow.description:
If one arrow is not enough, make it two, three... until one is gasping for air, the arms trembling, and the armor that seemed so impregnable, shattered to pieces.
<@lv.item><Originium Jetstream></> Continuously generates currents of airflow. Operators deployed downstream/upstream will deal increased/decreased damage; Enemies moving downstream/upstream will have increased/decreased Movement Speed.

char_147_shining.name: Rock-firm Protection
char_147_shining.description:
Shining uses Originium Arts to heal the wounded and strengthen allied defenses. She is a good fit with decoy tactics that call for a single Operator to draw enemy fire, opening up room for other Operators to deal damage. Proper assignment of Medic Operators, in particular Shining, is very important.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.
<@lv.item><Turrets></> Periodically fire bolts, dealing Physical Damage to our units.

char_112_siege.name: Heading the Charge
char_112_siege.description:
Vina never thinks about why she is always at the forefront. From the streets to the battlefield, it has always been her nature to lead from the front, charging fearlessly into the fray with her hammer. When the time comes to raise a cup to celebrate, however, she reminds herself that she must continue to do so, when she comes face to face with the shadow that she had been fighting for so long.
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>
<@lv.item><Bush></> Operators deployed on this tile will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks.

char_1023_ghost2.name: Reflection
char_1023_ghost2.description: One mirror—two selves—one body. Under normal circumstances, the two wouldn't have the chance to fight side by side. With some special adjustments to a very special simulacrum, Specter can now, if but for a brief moment, revel in that very joy.

char_4104_coldst.name: Staying Sober
char_4104_coldst.description: Helena keeps a steady hand in battle. Even if a brawl breaks out while she's enjoying a drink, it's as though alcohol has no effect on her. Her trigger finger stays steady, sending bullets straight into the enemy's vitals. If she's asked how she pulls it off, she always says that whenever she's finished her drink and washing up, she sobers up the moment she considers how expensive glass is and how much of a pain cleaning it up would be. On the battlefield, the same applies. Every loaded bullet should be treated as your last.

char_498_inside.name: Step By Step
char_498_inside.description:
'Load the bullet, fire. Tell your colleagues to get in position, fire. Place a jammer, fire. Watch for targets in the sky, fire. See? Just your average training session. Not so difficult, right?'
<@lv.item><Jammer></> Prevents nearby enemy drones from attacking, greatly reduces their speed, and disables their special abilities.

char_4130_luton.name: Raise Your Shield
char_4130_luton.description: Cleaning up after a battle means exposing yourself to unknown dangers. Unsprung traps, concealed crossbows, hidden enemies... Lutonada has long since learned to keep herself safe in such an environment. Raise your shield, observe the enemy, stay protected, survive.

char_4100_caper.name: Here Comes Twirly-twirl
char_4100_caper.description:
Caper fears no one on the streets, because no one plays a practical joke like she can. Just throw Twirly-twirl out, and everyone will be twirling around it. Don't believe it? See who catches who first! Oh, don't forget the bombs, too.
<@lv.item><Mr. Boom></> Stun all enemies in the four adjacent tiles for a long duration.

char_302_glaze.name: Regional Silence
char_302_glaze.description:
Ambriel is in position. This place offers a good view of enemy movements, and with her sharp senses, she will not miss a single intruder, even under complete radio silence.
More importantly, it offers cover from the afternoon sun, allowing her to take a little nap when there is nothing to do.

char_4114_harold.name: Doctor by Exposure
char_4114_harold.description:
Harold is far from the most learned doctor; he never attended medical school, and most of what he knows is self-taught. His experience makes up for his deficiencies in theoretical knowledge, however.
You can trust Ol' Harold's remedies in battle; they may be surprising, but they always work.

char_4081_warmy.name: Bright Furnace
char_4081_warmy.description:
A big pot of meat and vegetable soup, a big potato and carrot pie, the sights and sounds from deep inside the mines, and legends at the dinner table... the life of a Rim Billiton family is plain and simple.
Warmy has learned proper casting with the help of other operators since she joined the Rhodes Island family. Her stove brings not just a warm and hearty meal, but also a fire to light the darkness and drive out the cold.
<@lv.item><Heat Pump Passage></> Periodically deals great damage to any units on it.

char_1016_agoat2.name: A Scholar's Strength
char_1016_agoat2.description:
How would people describe Eyjafjalla? A scientist obsessed with observing volcanoes, always willing to lend a helping hand from the rear? The student of all you older researchers? Maybe even the mentor of many herself?
She doesn't mind which answer people go for. She simply stands where she is needed, holds her staff tight, and does everything she sets her mind to.

char_311_mudrok.name: Army Of One
char_311_mudrok.description:
The strength of earth and stone teems all around her. Mudrock needs only stand here on her lonesome, and her 'friends' will come, towering over her to form an unbreakable barrier.
<@lv.item><Nightfall></> Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible.
<@lv.item><City Neon></> Provides an initial amount of visibility, and can further increase visibility when used.

char_4017_puzzle.name: Unseen Weapon
char_4017_puzzle.description:
Maybe it's gathering crucial intelligence before a major operation, or maybe it's solving problems hidden around a corner. Operators rarely get the chance to stand alongside Fischer on the field to meet the enemy, but they know this 'unseen weapon' has his own battlefields.
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>

char_464_cement.name: Unstoppable Force
char_464_cement.description:
Doesn't matter if it's facing down tough strata underground, or the trials and tribulations of life, Shana Moleman revs up her drill, raises her shield, then breaks down the blockages one by one.
Just remember, you've got to wear a safety helmet, even if you're confident in your skills!
<@lv.item><Gramophone></> Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, deals Arts damage to enemies and heals allies.

char_4106_bryota.name: Against the Storm
char_4106_bryota.description:
Enis hasn't got much experience fighting, but he does his best to adapt. Battles can be fickle, just like greeting customers coming in from bustling Fashion Street, or surfing on Old Siesta's sea. Sometimes it's smooth sailing, other times it's a violent surge.
But he's always believed that as long as there are people with him against the storm, he'll be able to see the sunshine on the other side.

char_1034_jesca2.name: Shielded Maneuver
char_1034_jesca2.description: Being a defender hasn't crushed Jessica under the weight of her equipment. Enemies who think they got the jump on her do not know that they face not just bullets, but shields and gunfire.

char_377_gdglow.name: Shining Moment
char_377_gdglow.description: Operators are often in awe at Goldenglow's ability to remotely control Driftbeacons. Susie wishes she could help operators in need cut their hair from across the battlefield.

char_416_zumama.name: Iron Chieftain
char_416_zumama.description:
Eunectes was asked whether her machines count as her own strength in the eyes of Acahualla.
In response, Eunectes told the story of how she walked into the ring with High Priest and the Big Ugly Thing, to the stunned expressions of the watching Archosauria.
'And I told them, they can all come at me at the same time, for however long they want.'
The bout lasted all the way from noon to sunset, and it was Eunectes who emerged victorious.
<@lv.item><Medical Rune></> Operators deployed on this tile will restore HP over time.
<@lv.item><Giant Mushroom></> Increases the DEF of neighboring allied units.

char_198_blackd.name: Shadow Guard
char_198_blackd.description:
Courier prefers to operate in the rear, but that does not mean he is reluctant to fight, only that everything is already in place, and fighting is merely the last resort.
Be relieved when he stands by your side, because that means you need not worry about most of your worries anymore.
<@lv.item><Icy Surface></> Applies 'Cold' to units on top of it, and increases the distance Frozen enemies on it are shifted.
<@lv.item><Penetrating Cold></> During Snowfall, all enemies are pushed in a certain direction.
<@lv.item><Snowsant's Safe Escape Crane></> Immediately withdraws an Operator, and greatly reduces Redeployment Time.

char_4072_ironmn.name: Long-range Firepower
char_4072_ironmn.description: When terrain's so bad that your fire can't cover the enemy and you're in a deadlock, that's when your cheery smith and his handy thingamabobs come in to save the day in a whole new way.

char_4109_baslin.name: Taking Responsibility
char_4109_baslin.description: With Grimmacht gone, Michael's been giving serious thought to how he can manage the whole band, so to speak. How to live up to Grimmacht's hopes, and his own expectations.

char_405_absin.name: Relay Operation
char_405_absin.description:
She's more than capable of leading now, but Absinthe still usually opts to serve as a regular squad member. Matching the team's pace, covering for her squadmates, ending battles with precision and efficiency... It all serves to keep reminding her: 'You're not alone.'
<@lv.item><Originium Jetstream> </>Continuously generates currents of airflow. Operators deployed downstream/upstream will deal increased/decreased damage; Enemies moving downstream/upstream will have increased/decreased Movement Speed.

char_4011_lessng.name: Great Rending Edge
char_4011_lessng.description: Lessing always keeps his greatsword under wraps, bound away, and tries not to scare anyone with it. But on the battlefield, no longer must he be bound.

char_4078_bdhkgt.name: Wheeling the Desert
char_4078_bdhkgt.description: This Anasa girl's simple-minded and one-track, but in the field, all she needs to know is when to act. Once the enemy's all in one place, she'll send her wheel flying, and leave them there to lie in the great golden sands.

char_245_cello.name: Geflüster des Teufels
char_245_cello.description: In Virtuosa's eyes, there are no enemies, only audiences. Even in the worst battlefields, there is no warfare to her, only grandiose concerts. To any operating alongside her, beware: Do not approach her even out of curiosity. Do not wander into her performance.

char_499_kaitou.name: A Great Thief's Keen Eye
char_499_kaitou.description:
Diamante's wicked gaze as a jewelry appraiser always has its use on the battlefield.
When a target's begging to be taken by him, oh, he'll notice. And take it he will, sparing no scruples, the spitting image of the Thief Who Never Failed.

char_194_leto.name: Pounding the War Drums
char_194_leto.description:
While Leto and Zima are both charged with breaking enemy lines, their battlefield duties are as different as can be.
If Zima is the flag everyone rallies around, then Leto is no doubt the beating drum that inspires them. When the drum starts going, everyone is on the same page: it's time for an all-out attack!

char_4080_lin.name: 'Lin the Violet'
char_4080_lin.description:
Do not ask where Miss Lin is, or what she happens to be doing. She will make herself known at the most suitable time and place. All you need to do is watch her solve every problem with beauty and grace, before she disappears into the sand.
You need not show your amazement, nor gratitude, because this is simply how things are. She is 'Lin the Violet', the new Rat King.

char_4119_wanqin.name: With the Aid of the Wind
char_4119_wanqin.description: Our operators have unanimously described Wanqing's logistics work as 'reliable'. His eyes are as sharp as his Tianshi apparatus, able to accurately pinpoint which areas need the most help.

char_4122_grabds.name: Clouds Stop to Listen
char_4122_grabds.description: Grain Buds has lots of ways to make a noisy crowd quiet down. She picks up her flute and plays a few lively notes, which always ends up more effective than simply yelling at them.

char_2025_shu.name: Homeward Bound
char_2025_shu.description: The clouds part to reveal a fine day, the clear blue sky an open invitation to act at your leisure. Once you have stepped into the fields, what rush is there to leave? You may as well join her as she rests, and enjoy the fine view together.

char_430_fartth.name: Listen to the Wind
char_430_fartth.description: Be it Pinus Sylvestris or Rhodes Island, Justyna is used to being on the back lines. The quiet crack shot Fartooth Knight seems hard to get along with, but don't worry—she's actually glad to hear your voice on the wind.

char_003_kalts.name: Specimen of Civilization
char_003_kalts.description:
She has seen the strongest powers on this land, the passing of time, the cycles of civilization, the corrosion of blades. Might wears down from inner conflict, while unparalleled power becomes the source of self-destruction.
Violence cannot save a civilization on the verge of collapse, but what is truly lamentable is the fact that it is part of medical treatment.
Kal'tsit is an expert on the subject.
<@lv.item><Exhaust Grilles></> Operators deployed on it will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks.

char_451_robin.name: 'Bad Guys Stay Out'
char_451_robin.description:
Design and install traps for surprise attacks... Perhaps the inspiration from this combat tactic stems from that holiday movie 'Haven Alone'?
<@lv.item><Ursus Civilian> </>Depletes a Life Point when killed by an enemy.

char_211_adnach.name: Overlooking the Battlefield
char_211_adnach.description:
Operators alongside Adnachiel share a common belief—trust in his judgement.
He doesn't come up with comprehensive strategies like the Doctor, but when he shares his thoughts with you, just trust in him and you'll usually get a good result.

char_187_ccheal.name: Axe or Staff
char_187_ccheal.description:
Gavial has always had a straightforward way of thinking. If the jungle needs it, she'll brandish her axe to rid it of threats, or wave her medic staff to treat her companions' wounds. She's long known that the staff in her hands is sometimes stronger than her axe.
<@lv.item><Bush> </> Operators deployed on this tile will not be targeted by enemy ranged attacks.
<@lv.item><Giant Mushroom></> Increases the DEF of neighboring allied units.
<@lv.item><Rhodes Island Temporary Employee></> Clean up Giant Mushrooms and create deployable high-ground tiles

char_4173_nowell.name: Helping Hand
char_4173_nowell.description: It is new territory for Nowell, not standing at the front and taking shots for others. The new challenge is a demanding one that requires attention and awareness, but he will get used to it.

char_271_spikes.name: No Escape
char_271_spikes.description: Arene likes to stay in a corner, citing the dangers of his Arts. He cares little about the skeptical gazes of others, or their evasive attitudes. However, pique his curiosity, or worse, pick a fight with him, and woe be upon you... for keeping your distance will not save you then.

char_4098_vvana.name: Lonely Candle
char_4098_vvana.description:
Sometimes operators see a candlelight in the most crucial place on the battlefield, supporting layer after layer of halo at night, and pouring shadow after shadow during the day.
None ever imagined light and shadow could form a wall that not even wind can pass through.

char_4138_narant.name: My Way
char_4138_narant.description: Narantuya has been in her share of predicaments. To her enemies, she is in the way, whether they are trying to get somewhere, get rich, or get up in the world. Narantuya cares little about whose path she is in; the desert is big, and there are plenty of paths. She has no interest in those that have had their ups and downs trodden flat.

char_4079_haini.name: Dome Gazer
char_4079_haini.description: Few ask Lucilla how she manages to accurately predict enemy movements; most could not understand all the technical jargon that comes out of her mouth, and these questions always make her overly excited and attempt to peddle some prototype device of unknown purpose. All they need to know is that she has never missed a danger sign.

char_362_saga.name: Between Light and Darkness
char_362_saga.description: Saga often fought Ink Spirits in the scrolls. After some time, she realized their personalities reflect how they are treated. Learn from them, and they are friendly; oppose them, and they are hostile. That which are alike are attracted to each other; that which are different are repelled by each other. Saga thought she had seen through the simple logic of the Ink Spirits, until the day she broke through the painting, and something occurred to her: A soul in a mortal realm, versus ink on paper; what attracts them to each other, or repels them from each other?

char_4117_ray.name: The Sandbeast and the Crossbow
char_4117_ray.description: The life of a pitsinker has acclimated Ray to various enemies and challenges that may appear, sometimes even exceeding what she is able to deal with. As long as she has her sandbeast and crossbow, however, she is confident that she can find that light which belongs to her.

char_4151_tinman.name: 'Fast Food Feast'
char_4151_tinman.description: Tin Man gained a few tiny companions when he came back from Kazdel. Even enemies could not help but have their attention drawn to the tiny things climbing up and down—hot dog, hamburger and donut? Curiosity is relative, however, and the revenants that have escaped the furnace are also curious about the well-equipped individual in front of them. 'Stop fooling around,' warned Tin Man before he threw them. A 'Fast Food Feast' of the clash of ancient witchcraft and modern technology is about to begin.

char_4165_ctrail.name: Do Not Look Up
char_4165_ctrail.description: Step forward... take off! Those who bury their heads in the ground will never know what the sky means.

char_4162_cathy.name: Backing
char_4162_cathy.description: I will do my duty, and you do what you can. Believe in me, and we'll all pull through.

char_136_hsguma.name: No Way Out
char_136_hsguma.description: You fear that she has no way out, but she looks unconcerned. It is the foes in front of her that feel like they are being backed into a corner.

char_4140_lasher.name: Inferior Goods
char_4140_lasher.description: Gems that cannot go onto the market, for whatever reason, are typically dealt with using the clockwork fowlbeast. After making contact with Rhodes Island, Sand Reckoner has decided to deal with enemies in the same way.

char_4139_papyrs.name: Order in Busyness
char_4139_papyrs.description: Read the thick notebook in Papyrus's hand, and you will understand how she always manages to deliver support to the right person.

char_4146_nymph.name: Facing the Soul
char_4146_nymph.description: As a Djall, Nymph is able to sense the feelings that others try to hide. She must be careful about this ability in Kazdel, however, lest the anger and hate overcome her. She does not want to run away, though. Time after time, she musters the courage to face the storms of the soul, opening a path with her key-whip. She believes that she has seen a light at the end of the seemingly boundless storm.

char_445_wscoot.name: Courtesy Before Violence
char_445_wscoot.description: Even when faced with bandits blocking the path, he believes it's not impossible to persuade them to turn back—Windscoot believes that forsaking violence is the first step to helping the elders of the Gang of Justice leave banditry behind. But he is not afraid of violence, if it comes to that.

char_1038_whitw2.name: Player
char_1038_whitw2.description: Lappland's foes come from both civilization and wilderness. The same goes for the help that she has found.

char_431_ashlok.name: The Roar
char_431_ashlok.description: Who says Ashlock is the most conservative fighter in Pinus Sylvestris? Cover your ears and hide behind her. Offense is a form of defense for an Infected knight who has lived and fought in Kazimierz.

char_4147_mitm.name: Busybody
char_4147_mitm.description: When did the Consultant become the Consultant? Even he himself does not know. All those conflicts were not meant to be any of his business, but he had a hard time not making it his business when he watched from the sideline.

char_487_bobb.name: Anger of the Gentle
char_487_bobb.description: If you have ever seen Eliseo fight over a single box of Oripathy medicine, you would know better than to underestimate him from the way he looks.

char_4191_tippi.name: Crisis on Set
char_4191_tippi.description: Several uninvited guests intrude upon the set, approaching the background that Tippi had just painted... Nothing must get in the way of the shoot!

char_4134_cetsyr.name: Unfinished Simulation
char_4134_cetsyr.description: She finds an unnamed simulation record in the Doctor's terminal, which had been interrupted halfway. After viewing it, she logs out of the system, and deletes her browsing history.

char_4116_blkkgt.name: The Path Beneath Our Feet
char_4116_blkkgt.description: Tschäggättä recruits have all experienced the shame of being thrown down the mountain by her. When they complain to the veterans, the vets smile and pull open their uniforms to reveal two layers of weighted vests underneath.

char_1011_lava2.name: Fruits of Training
char_1011_lava2.description: Lava's Arts are leaps and bounds ahead of where they used to be, covering the battlefield in scorching flames. She will not stop working hard as long as there is still someone to protect.

char_4203_kichi.name: Reward Time
char_4203_kichi.description: The most exhilarating part of pachinko is the 10x bonus time. If only the same happened on the battlefield!

char_202_demkni.name: Dead End
char_202_demkni.description: Everyone knows what it means for Saria to stand on the battlefield. Push forward, for she has your back.

char_4023_rfalcn.name: Color of Honor
char_4023_rfalcn.description: She is no longer bound by her past, but if anyone dares threaten what she is defending, they will find out why her 'bite marks' were once red as blood.

char_4199_makiri.name: Trump Card
char_4199_makiri.description: Calm, talkative, confident... No need to be surprised about his eagerness to take risks, or worry about how he finds a way out. He is planning an elaborate game of cards, and the ace up his sleeve will soon make a grand appearance.

char_4148_philae.name: Before the Living
char_4148_philae.description: Philae is not the kind to let fate walk all over her. She is a strong defender who is responsible for all the lives behind her. She will not falter, lament, or take a single step back until the foe has completely withered.

char_4163_rosesa.name: ¡Hola, Hermanos y Hermanas!
char_4163_rosesa.description: A recent Iberian rumor speaks of a sweet-tongued girl who visits gangs of villains from time to time, and they would disappear within a week. Insiders reveal that the girl is actually a terrifying diablo, and even the worst villain has their villainy scared out of them when they see her.

char_4164_tecno.name: Puppet Masquerade
char_4164_tecno.description: No need to fear hordes of enemies, or snipers taking shots from a distance. Tecno's outlandish ideas and creations will help you deal with them all, as long as you watch your feet... and are not afraid of ghosts.

char_420_flamtl.name: Candlelight at Midnight
char_420_flamtl.description: Everyone knows that Flametail Knight's calling cards are speed and agility, in which few are her equal. Everyone knows that Flametail Knight's charms are her ideals and smile, which few can resist. This is Flametail Knight, burning bright.

char_4171_wulfen.name: Make a Path
char_4171_wulfen.description: Wulfenite's exploration gear can adapt to any terrain. Be it rugged mountains or dangerous caverns, the Ore 'Killer' can make its own path. Set it up around boulders or enemies, then... boom!

char_494_vendla.name: Thorned Rose
char_494_vendla.description: Vendela knew what she was getting into when she joined the Self-Salvation Corps. She knew that being in the rear does not mean being safe from tragedy. She knew she was not so brave, but she never looked back, because she knew she must face pain head-on, in order to witness its ending.

char_2026_yu.name: No Entry
char_2026_yu.description: As pots and pans clang in the kitchen, the diners taste not just with their tongues, but with their hearts as well. The dishes witness people come and go, and reflect one's own visage. Where the firewood burns is therefore very important to him, and he will not allow any invader to destroy it.

char_4172_xingzh.name: Rare Transgression
char_4172_xingzh.description: Ning Yin is always cautious, always mindful, loathe to make even the slightest misstep. Never in her wildest dreams did she imagine that she would commit such an absurd transgression as to crash the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. But in that moment, it was what she had to do.

char_289_gyuki.name: Oni of Justice
char_289_gyuki.description: Unspeakable evil dwells beneath the neon signs of Mitsukue. Those caught in its grasp may know, yet find it impossible to uphold justice. Matoimaru will abide no such evil. The Higashinese Oni of Justice, yoroshiku.

char_4177_brigid.name: Before the Flowers Wilt
char_4177_brigid.description:
She hoped that time would give her an answer, but all she got was a wilted flower. She accepted that she must go forth on her own, and take a resolute step towards dawn.
<@lv.item><Tattered Pillar></> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.

char_1502_crosly.name: Wind Over the Snow
char_1502_crosly.description:
Lyudmila is never shy about announcing her presence.
The spread of her smoke loudly announces that the assassin has taken the field. It strikes fear into her enemy's hearts, for they know that death inevitably accompanies it.
They search and swing their weapons in vain, watching helplessly as she walks out of the smoke...
Like the wind over the snow.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.

char_4207_branch.name: The End of Night
char_4207_branch.description:
Before departure, she counted the numbers over and over. Perhaps she had counted wrong, for they kept getting smaller, or perhaps she was right and...
'Seven hundred twenty-three, seven hundred twenty-two, seven hundred twenty-one...'
Her voice grows softer, but her strength grows stronger. She rings her shield, like the bell tolling for the departed.
She makes a wish for everyone:
'Survive.'
<@lv.item><Hidden Tunnel></> Once activated, toggles the standby/deployed status of Miner Guerrillas assembled here.
<@lv.item><Heavily Polluted Facility></> Creates Toxic Pollution around it that prevents deployment and makes enemies invisible.

char_4208_wintim.name: Long Winter Days
char_4208_wintim.description:
It is not easy, carving a path out in the vast snowfields.
The wind and snow are fierce, and vicious beasts circle. When the long night falls, when the path is dark and the end nowhere in sight, fear will visit the hearts of even the strongest.
Perhaps it is another kind of companion you need.
She is thin, frail, as though the blizzard could blow her over any moment.
But she keeps going.
<@lv.rem>DP does not regenerate normally in this operation.</>
